messages:
Maya K (partnerships): kickoff: EdgeHub interoperability pilot scope — goal is validating Snowflake external tables -> EdgeHub vector lookup, and Delta Lake batch sync -> Qdrant-compatible vectors. Need owners + acceptance criteria.
Ravi N (edgehub): happy to run the EdgeHub appliance for the pilot. we expose an S3 sink, an HTTP lookup API, and optional Kafka export.
Lena S (eng): perfect. From Redwood runtime we need: 1) an http lookup endpoint with JSON-RPC v1, 2) TLS + client cert support, 3) request-level tracing header propagation (X-Request-ID).
Ravi N (edgehub): all supported. lookup path: POST /v1/lookup with body {"queries": [...]}. supports mTLS; cert rotation supported via our /admin/certs endpoint.
Jon C (product): timeline: pilot start in 4 weeks, 2-week test window. deliverables before start: runbook, packaging (OCI + helm), test dataset (10K vectors), acceptance tests.
Maya K (partnerships): add co-announcement checklist: embargo window, quote placeholders, joint blog owner, marketplace listing owner.
Sara B (marketing): i'll draft the blog outline. need logos, short partner blurb, and a joint quote from partner PM. target PR week after pilot completion.
Legal Bot: reminder: for on-prem connectors we require the runbook + security checklist in the partner legal package. please tag @Legal for SLA language.
Lena S (eng): acceptance criteria (tech): 1) cold lookup P95 < 120ms for 128-dim vectors, 2) batch delta ingestion of 100K records completes under 30m, 3) fallback routing to Redwood-hosted vectors when EdgeHub returns 5xx.
Ravi N (edgehub): we can aim for those numbers on c5.large-equivalent hardware, will document hardware profiles. fallback behavior: return 502 with header `X-EdgeHub-Retry: true` when cache miss; or 503 on full outage.
Maya K (partnerships): ops asks: install notes (ports: 443, 9000), firewall rules, minimal rpm/deb package, and docker-compose quickstart.
Ravi N (edgehub): we'll provide rpm/deb and compose. also an Openshift/K8s helm chart for marketplace packaging. image: registry.edgehub.io/edgehub/connector:2026.03.
Lena S (eng): build integration stub in our connector repo. need manifest keys: image, envs (EDGEHUB_URL, EDGEHUB_CERT_PATH), readinessProbe path (/v1/health). health response should be {"uptime":"...","status":"ok"} as a 200.
Jon C (product): marketplace acceptance criteria: OCI image available, helm chart, security scan report, and a short integration test that runs during listing validation.
Sara B (marketing): confirm joint messaging: emphasize private-data-first inference and predictable latency. partner wants to highlight "low-latency on-prem option".
Ravi N (edgehub): agreed. also we need to agree on logos + trademark usage. we'll share brand guidelines.
Lena S (eng): test plan: 1) smoke test: 100 queries/sec for 5m, 2) correctness: sample queries vs. golden set, 3) chaos: simulate node restart and assert automatic failover to remote route within 30s.
Maya K (partnerships): owners: Ravi = partner artifacts, Lena = integration tests + perf, Jon = pilot scope + acceptance, Sara = comms, Legal Bot = contract attachments.
Legal Bot: please attach custom MSA addendum if storing metadata on-prem or transferring outside customer region.
ops-bot: created channel #pilot-edgehub-interop and added participants.
Ravi N (edgehub): we'll drop initial artifact bundle to the channel: runbook, helm chart, sample configs, and a small python test harness for ingestion.
Lena S (eng): quick request: include a Snowflake external table example that points at S3 sink and an example Databricks notebook for Delta ingestion.
Ravi N (edgehub): will include both. Snowflake snippet will show external table + COPY INTO from staging S3.
Jon C (product): milestone dates: artifacts by 1841008000, internal test pass by 1841012000, pilot start 1841015000.
Maya K (partnerships): thanks everyone. next check-in Thurs 9am PT. drop blockers in channel before then. :+1:
